plugins.name: C Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in main(), add include guards, extern "C" blocks, and typedef structs from fields.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in int main(void). Wrap a header in an include guard derived from the file name, add extern "C" for C++ consumers, or turn lines like "int x;" into a typedef struct.

plugins.name: Comment Wrapper
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Comment out or uncomment code, add block and doc comments, using the syntax of the document's language.
plugins.documentation: Comment or uncomment the selected lines with the right marker for the document language (// for C-style languages, # for Python/Ruby/Shell/YAML, -- for SQL/Lua, ; for Lisp/INI, % for LaTeX). Block Comment wraps the selection in /* */, <!-- -->, =begin/=end and friends; Doc Comment makes a Javadoc/JSDoc block, a Python docstring or /// lines.

plugins.name: C++ Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in main(), try/catch or a namespace, and generate a class with constructor and getters.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in int main() or try/catch (std::exception). Wrap declarations in a namespace, or turn member lines like "std::string name;" into a class with a constructor, const getters and trailing-underscore members.

plugins.name: Go Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in func main(), an error-returning function or a goroutine, and generate structs from fields.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in package main / func main(), a func returning error, or go func() { ... }(). Select lines like "Name string" to generate a struct named after the file. Output uses tabs, as gofmt does.

plugins.name: Java Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in a main method or try/catch, generate getters/setters and records from fields.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in public static void main or try/catch. Select field declarations such as "private String name;" and generate getters and setters (boolean fields get isX, final fields get no setter) or a record. The class or record name comes from the file name.

plugins.name: JavaScript & TypeScript Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in an IIFE, async main(), try/catch or a DOMContentLoaded handler.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in a strict-mode IIFE, an async main() entry point with error handling, try/catch, or a DOMContentLoaded listener. Works for JavaScript and TypeScript.

plugins.name: JSON Wrapper
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Embed JSON in source code as a string literal, styled for the document's language (Java, Python, C, C++, C#, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby, Shell).
plugins.documentation: Select JSON (or leave nothing selected for the whole document) and run "Wrap JSON for Current Language": the plugin picks the right literal style from the document language - Java text block, Python triple-quoted string, adjacent C string literals, C++ raw string, C# verbatim string, JS template literal, Go/Rust/Swift raw strings, Kotlin raw string, PHP nowdoc, Ruby heredoc or a single-quoted shell string. Use the "Wrap as..." commands to choose a language explicitly (handy in a .json file). The text must be valid JSON; "Minified" compacts it first.

commands.title: Wrap Minified JSON for Current Language

plugins.name: Python Tools
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Wrap code in main(), try/except or a function, and turn field lines into a dataclass.
plugins.documentation: Select statements and wrap them in def main() with the if __name__ guard, a try/except block or a function. Select lines like "name: str" or "count: int = 0" to generate a @dataclass named after the file.

plugins.name: Text Case Converter
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Convert text to UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case.
plugins.documentation: Select some text (or leave nothing selected to convert the whole document) and pick a conversion from Plugins > Text Case Converter. camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case are applied line by line.

plugins.name: URL & HTML Codec
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Encode and decode URL components and HTML entities.
plugins.documentation: Percent-encode or decode URL text, and escape or unescape HTML entities (&, <, ', 😀 and friends) in the selection or the whole document.

plugins.name: Whitespace Cleaner
plugins.author: NPad++ Community
plugins.summary: Trim trailing spaces, remove or collapse blank lines, and convert tabs to spaces.
plugins.documentation: Tidy up pasted or generated text. Works on the selection, or on the whole document when nothing is selected.
